# lib/debounce module

Vendor-agnostic digital-input debouncer. This page is the reference for the `lib/debounce` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/debounce` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/debounce). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872, 16F873, 16F873A, 16F874, 16F874A, 16LF873A, 18F2455, 18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
